MATHEMATICS — GENERAL ASSESSMENT #19
====

GRADE: Grade 8
SUBJECT: MATHEMATICS
TIME ALLOWED: 45 minutes
TOTAL MARKS: 30
EXAM BODY: KJSEA

INSTRUCTIONS
----
1. Answer all questions.
2. For calculations, show formula → substitution → steps → final answer with units.
3. For multiple choice, choose the best option.
4. Check your work before submitting.

SECTION A — MULTIPLE CHOICE
----
1. Solve for x: x + 7 = 14. (1 mark)
   A. 14
   B. 8
   C. 7
   D. 7

2. What is 4 × 9? (1 mark)
   A. 37
   B. 5
   C. 36
   D. 13

3. A square plot has side 6 m. What is its area in m²? (1 mark)
   A. 24
   B. 36
   C. 42
   D. 12

4. 1 hectare equals how many square metres? (1 mark)
   A. 100 m²
   B. 1000 m²
   C. 100 000 m²
   D. 10 000 m²

5. A square plot has side 12 m. What is its area in m²? (1 mark)
   A. 144
   B. 48
   C. 156
   D. 24

6. What is 4 × 7? (1 mark)
   A. 29
   B. 3
   C. 28
   D. 11

7. In the number 3543, what is the place value of digit 4? (1 mark)
   A. 400
   B. 10
   C. 4
   D. 40

8. What is the square of 7? (1 mark)
   A. 14
   B. 50
   C. 49
   D. 7

9. In the number 3143, what is the place value of digit 4? (1 mark)
   A. 10
   B. 40
   C. 4
   D. 400

10. A square plot has side 9 m. What is its area in m²? (1 mark)
   A. 36
   B. 18
   C. 81
   D. 90

11. What is 4 × 4? (1 mark)
   A. 0
   B. 16
   C. 8
   D. 17

12. Which fraction is equivalent to 6/8? (1 mark)
   A. 1/4
   B. 2/3
   C. 1/2
   D. 3/4

SECTION B — STRUCTURED / SHORT ANSWERS
----
13. Show full working: A trader sells 14 items at Ksh 80 each. Find the total money collected. (4 marks)

14. Show full working: A trader sells 15 items at Ksh 85 each. Find the total money collected. (4 marks)

15. Show full working: A trader sells 16 items at Ksh 90 each. Find the total money collected. (4 marks)

16. Show full working: A trader sells 17 items at Ksh 95 each. Find the total money collected. (4 marks)
